title: Sunday Sessions at Peninsula Hot Springs
summary: Live music every Sunday from midday at Peninsula Hot Springs, played to the pools and included with bathing. Brad Kennedy on 20 September, The Calmer Miles on 27 September.
recurrenceNote: Every Sunday from 12pm; performer changes weekly
weatherDependency: Covered and outdoor bathing areas, low dependency
nearbyAttractions: Rye back beach; St Andrews Beach; Cape Schanck
suggestedItineraryPairing: Book a midday bathing session, catch the set, eat at the Bath House Cafe after
editorVerdict: Book the bathe and the music comes with it. The easiest good Sunday on this end of the Peninsula.
editorNote:
Live music runs from midday every Sunday, played to the pools rather than ticketed separately. Entry is by bathing session, so book a bathing time and the music comes with it.

The line-up rolls week to week. Brad Kennedy plays 20 September and The Calmer Miles play 27 September; the October performers are not yet listed, so check the venue's events page for the current Sunday before you go.

It pairs an afternoon soak with a set, which makes it an easy plan for the spring school-holiday Sundays and the weeks after.
